restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic. The doctor did not properly examine me or take time to understand my condition. Instead, I was quickly told to take a COVID-19 test without much explanation.

After that, the receptionist simply asked for payment and handed me the medication. There was no clear explanation about what the medicines were for or how I should take them, which felt very unprofessional and unsafe.

The cost was also unexpectedly high. I was charged 1200 baht for only three types of medicine, and an additional 450 baht for the COVID-19 test. Considering the lack of proper consultation and guidance, the pricing does not feel reasonable.

Overall, the service lacked professionalism, clear communication, and proper patient care. I would not recommend this clinic based on my experience.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
Conveniently located on Rama IV.  I came to get a doctor’s certificate for drivers license renewal. The whole process took 15 minutes.

The doctor spoke fluent English and was kind, friendly and warm.

Everyone was so friendly and helpful. The best was Nurse Samlat who was absolutely wonderful. She even gave me tips on the easiest Transport Office to go for the renewal!

What a pleasant experience!  The place is a bit old but it is affordable, clean and efficient with compassionate staff.  What more can you ask for?

Highly recommend!

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: Came here for driving license health certificate staff speak a little bit English. The cost is 250 bhat . The whole process takes five minutes.  Location is opposite one Bangkok, which is very convenient.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
I went today for my eye check-up. I have irritation and infection on my eye.
The doctor was very nice, he diagnosed really well and gave me ointment and eye drops,  and some medicines.
Total amount 750b.

It was a good experience.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: A WWII clinic on Bangkok.  I don't think that they have renovated it since the Nazi and Japs  surrendered. A nostalgic place . Old administrators will make you feel like 1944.  Hope you won't have a bad dream later. LOL.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: Never had I felt so well treated in my life. Ignore all the naysayers who whine and moan over nothing.. Without places like this Thais without wealth would suffer and be in more significant pain. The doctors and nurses here are genuine caregivers. Not like the rest of them chasing money. Be grateful

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: The nice nurse helped med get medical certificate for driver license, fast and affordable 💯 …

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: Old building but friendly staff . They tried to help a foreigner in distress !!

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: For us, the doctors here are very skilled, calm, a good listener, and give excellent advice. The prices are very reasonable, and they only accept bank transfers and cash.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
Don't worry about the building's age; it's very clean.

Personally, I found a very good doctor there for my shoulder arthritis; the injection was effective.

It cost 600 baht—why go to a large hospital and pay ten times more?

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
The clinic offers multidisciplinary treatments and sees a considerable number of patients.
It's an old-style building.
There is parking available.
The doctors are kind, some are elderly and speak in a trustworthy manner.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: Today I went to get a medical certificate for a job application. The service itself was good, but the price was a bit expensive for me. The total was 450 baht, which is more expensive than other places I've applied for certificates at.
author_name: จุไรวรรณ วันธิกุล

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: I used to have those spots all over my body, but as soon as I got the opaque white bottle with the blue cap of medicine, the sores disappeared immediately.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text:
This was my first time using their service. The elderly female assistant at the ENT (Ear, Nose, and Throat) clinic provided terrible service.
She made patients write their names and registration slips in a notebook. Some people only wrote their name, surname, and age, without their address. She frowned and said, "Why didn't you write your address? Don't you have an address?" Personally, I think she could have spoken more politely. Everyone is treated equally, and we're paying for the service, so the service should be better. Also, there should be a queuing system, not asking who came first or last.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: For us, we've been going here since we were children, and the doctor is still the same one. We're very surprised by how accurate the diagnosis is, allowing us to receive treatment according to our insurance coverage in a timely manner.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: I went for a checkup for a bladder infection. At first, it looked scary because the place seemed very old, but the doctor and nurses were very polite and courteous. The test results were quick, and it wasn't too crowded. The price was reasonable, not as expensive as other places.

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: I'd like to inquire... Do you have an ENT (Ear, Nose, and Throat) doctor available?

restaurant_name: ไชยแพทย์คลีนิก-25 (Chaibhaet Clinic-25)
text: Yesterday, I took my girlfriend to the doctor. When we went to pick up her medication, the nurse at the pharmacy didn't explain what medications she was taking at all. Usually, other places explain what medication to take and when. We were very confused. She didn't say anything except "The medication costs 1238฿" and handed us the bag of medicine. We were confused, and when we looked at the packaging, everything was in English. We had to use Google Translate to find out what medications were included. It was a terrible experience. We paid a lot for the medication, but we think the service should have been better.
